The design is fixed and all visible tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

I found and corrected two spec violations in `rtl/apb_regs.v` that the visible testbench didn't happen to trigger:
- **INT_STATUS priority bug**: a simultaneous hardware event and software clear on the same bit incorrectly let the clear win; now the set correctly wins per rule 8 (`(int_status & ~w1c_mask) | hw_event`).
- **CTRL reserved bit 3**: writes weren't forcing bit 3 to 0; now it's always masked to 0 regardless of `pwdata[3]`.
